def transform(grid):
    # Four isolated marker colors surround a 2x2 block; extend the diagonals
    # of same-color corner markers outward from the central square.
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Find connected 2x2 solid nonzero square.
    for r in range(h-1):

            v=grid[r][c]
            if v and grid[r][c+1]==v and grid[r+1][c]==v and grid[r+1][c+1]==v:
                # Corner markers at (r-1,c-1),(r-1,c+2),(r+2,c-1),(r+2,c+2)
                # rays continue outward on their diagonal.
                pairs=[(r-1,c-1,1,1),(r-1,c+2,1,-1),(r+2,c-1,-1,1),(r+2,c+2,-1,-1)]
                for sr,sc,dr,dc in pairs:

                        color=grid[sr][sc]
                        rr,cc=sr-dr,sc-dc
                        while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                            out[rr][cc]=color
                            rr-=dr; cc-=dc
                return out
    return out
